OpenAI

You can use all models on this page with both the Responses API and the Chat Completions API on bedrock-mantle. See each model card for details.

The following OpenAI models are available in Amazon Bedrock:

Model Description
GPT-6 AstraOpenAI's most capable model, built for complex reasoning, coding, computer use, research, and document creation.
GPT-5.6 SolThe most capable OpenAI model yet, delivering frontier reasoning and state-of-the-art agentic performance across coding, cybersecurity, and scientific research.
GPT-5.6 TerraBalanced performance competitive with GPT-5.5 at half the cost, built for everyday production workloads at scale.
GPT-5.6 LunaFast and affordable inference at OpenAI's lowest cost, built for high-volume tasks where speed and efficiency matter.
Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 CyberA highly specialized model for advanced tasks like vulnerability research, exploit reproduction, and mitigation development. Requires Trusted Access for Cyber enrollment.
Daybreak Blue: GPT-5.6 SolA specialized model for verified defenders conducting advanced, authorized cybersecurity work. Requires Trusted Access for Cyber enrollment.
GPT-5.5GPT-5.5 is OpenAI's most capable model for complex professional work, designed for advanced coding, research, analysis, software operation, document workflows, and long-running agentic tasks.
GPT-5.4GPT-5.4 brings frontier reasoning, coding, computer use, long-context workflows, and tool use to Amazon Bedrock for professional workflows that require reliable reasoning and action across complex business systems.
GPT OSS Safeguard 120BGPT OSS Safeguard 120B is OpenAI's 120-billion parameter open-source safety model for content moderation and guardrail enforcement in AI applications.
GPT OSS Safeguard 20BGPT OSS Safeguard 20B is OpenAI's compact 20-billion parameter open-source safety model for lightweight content moderation and guardrail tasks.
gpt-oss-120bGPT OSS 120B is OpenAI's 120-billion parameter open-source general-purpose model for text generation, coding, and reasoning tasks.
gpt-oss-20bGPT OSS 20B is OpenAI's 20-billion parameter open-source model for efficient text generation and coding at lower compute cost.
